openpyxl.name: openpyxl roundtrip

import openpyxl, tempfile, os
wb = openpyxl.Workbook(); ws = wb.active; ws['A1'] = 42
p = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'zcode_smoke.xlsx')
wb.save(p); wb2 = openpyxl.load_workbook(p); assert wb2.active['A1'].value == 42

matplotlib.name: matplotlib Agg PNG
matplotlib.code:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import tempfile, os
plt.plot([1, 2, 3]); p = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'zcode_smoke.png')
plt.savefig(p); assert os.path.getsize(p) > 0

pillow.name: pillow roundtrip

from PIL import Image
import tempfile, os
